services.desc: Booking a boat ride with Cleveland Boat Cruise is easy and there are a couple of ways to contact Captain Ray directly. You can email Captain Ray at captainrayd@outlook.com Please indicate the date and time you are interested in booking a boat ride and he will get back in touch with you. Or you can simply fill out the form on the website. Just click here to contact Captain
